# archestra_project (Data Source)

Finds a project by its exact name among the projects these credentials can see.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "archestra_project" "onboarding" {
  name = "Onboarding"
}

output "onboarding_project_id" {
  value = data.archestra_project.onboarding.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact name of the project.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Project description.
- `id` (String) Project ID.
- `visibility` (String) Who the project is shared with.
